title: FlowMat: a toolbox for modeling flow reactors using physics-based and machine learning approaches for modular simulation, parameter identification, and reactor optimization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33278-33296
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06173C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sebastian Knoll, Klara Silber, Jason D. Williams, Peter Sagmeister, Christopher A. Hone, C. Oliver Kappe, Martin Steinberger, Martin Horn
This paper introduces FlowMat, a versatile, open-source MATLAB/Simulink toolbox for modeling and optimizing flow reactors. The toolbox supports a modular setup and integrates simulation, parameter identification, and reactor optimization.
